!!!Clarification: (CW/TW: EXTREMELY PERSONAL STUFF AHEAD, READER BE AWARE)!!!


(tl:dr, /vp about personal stuff + extremely personal explanation about why relationships can be very difficult for me, reason why its so personal is b/c honestly i evoke an ‘energy’ so reminiscient of being a loser + that “there’s nothing wrong with him,” that it just makes me want to rip myself apart like crazy, so thats why this is extremely personal now, all of a sudden.)

I have Autism + ADHD, which for me specifically means I do struggle with relationships and how to understand them.

I have a hard time being able to reciprocate warmth from other friends due to trauma inflicted by my IRL life, making every action that I do possibly coming off as trying to “get something out of it”, or being socially distant from other friends. This can unfortunately be seen as me changing into a person that can be considered neurotypical or genuinely someone worth dropping for a lot of people due to how “generically out of place” and “overbearingly normal” I am, and it isn’t helping that my socialization skills are too blunt and direct whenever I talk.

I also have a really low attention span, which does make me have to ask for repeated sentences (i have no idea why this isn’t a problem during college (again me acting “overbearingly normal” again, which is why i self-hate every day, which i can’t help because i do genuinely think i’m that much of a threat to people that are genuinely able to break free from what ‘normal’ thinks they should be as people, more on this in the final paragraph)), this is a big-ish deal b/c there are quite a lot of times I get freaked out whenever I couldn’t respond to something even when I truly listened, making awkward pauses in conversations more anxiety inducing than usual for me.

Most importantly tbh, I still struggle significantly with letting go of IRL life, which leads to even more problems toward socializing with loved ones. I was obsessed with rules growing up, and so it eventually manifested in my relationships, despite me knowing that IRL life’s rules doesn’t have to be followed, and the people who are able to let go of what binds them to their norms, are people that I genuinely look up to, and why I am drawn to those people. Why do I eventually then, get influenced by those rules again and then lose those people that I’m attached to? I would say trauma, but it would sound like that would never change, and I really do want to change from what my trauma has inflicted upon me.

But not in the way that my change should ideally be according to society, but to eventually change into a person that not only understands, but sympathizes with people on an emotional level based on what their IRL lives have made them go through. I know I have a lot to understand too, but I will make it up to you. /gen /href

I don’t want to sound like a savant, nor do I want to sound like I’m trying to peel or pry so I can get what I want, because that is what society wants, not me. I genuinely want to be able to not only understand, but be able to be like you as well, because you were able to do something that I was too fearful to do at the time, and that was to be “you.”

I wish I could’ve done things differently. /lh /neu

-Blu
